intel.title: [CISA KEV] Ajax.NET Professional Ajax.NET Professional - Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2021-23758
廠商: Ajax.NET Professional
產品: Ajax.NET Professional
漏洞名稱: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
說明: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-09
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/michaelschwarz/Ajax.NET-Professional/commit/b0e63be5f0bb20dfce507cb8a1a9568f6e73de57 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-23758

analysis.summary: CISA 將 Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) 的反序列化漏洞 (CVE-2021-23758) 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單。遠端攻擊者可傳送惡意的 .NET 類別以執行任意程式碼，由於該元件可能已 EoL，官方建議停止使用。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Red Hat Libuser - Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2015-3246
廠商: Red Hat
產品: Libuser
漏洞名稱: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
說明: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation. 
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-09
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://access.redhat.com/articles/1537873 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2015-3246

analysis.summary: 此情資涉及 Red Hat libuser 的競爭條件漏洞（CVE-2015-3246），允許本地已驗證使用者損毀 /etc/passwd 檔案以進行權限提升或造成拒絕服務。由於該漏洞屬於 2015 年之舊漏洞，且公司並未使用 Red Hat 相關作業系統，因此評估無直接風險。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-09
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/commit/?id=93ce93587d36493f2f86921fa79921b3cba63fbb ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-0995

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2022-0995）為 Linux Kernel 的越界寫入漏洞，本地攻擊者可藉此提升權限或造成系統拒絕服務。由於該漏洞發布已超過 3 年，現代作業系統版本預設已套用補丁，整體風險較低，但仍需防範未更新的舊系統。
analysis.recommendation: 請 RR40 與 RR70 盤點並確認「資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Linux ubuntu」與「AWS EC2」等 Linux 虛擬主機的內核版本，確保已套用 2022 年 3 月以後的安全更新，或將內核升級至已修補之版本。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Linux ubuntu

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft SQL Server - Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2019-1068
廠商: Microsoft
產品: SQL Server
漏洞名稱: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-29
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 微軟 SQL Server 存在遠端程式碼執行漏洞（CVE-2019-1068），允許攻擊者在資料庫引擎服務帳戶上下文中執行任意程式碼。此漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV，但因屬 2019 年之舊漏洞且已有成熟補丁，在公司未明確列出受影響舊版本的情況下，風險評級為 Low。
analysis.recommendation: 請 RR40 盤點並確認「資訊軟體-資料庫軟體-MS SQL Server」之版本。若仍在使用 SQL Server 2014、2016 或 2017 等受影響版本，請立即套用微軟官方安全更新（例如升級至 SQL Server 2014 SP3 GDR、SQL Server 2016 SP2 GDR 或 SQL Server 2017 CU15 以上版本）以修補此漏洞。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-資料庫軟體-MS SQL Server
